review.summary: The fix commit 430e12e resolves the single finding from round 3 and introduces no new issues. It changes only the CONTRIBUTING.md paragraph about .git-blame-ignore-revs. The paragraph now says the file lists commits that are mostly mechanical formatting. It also says that the TASK-066B squash commit carries the task's CI, Makefile and documentation changes, which blame skips as well and may attribute to an unrelated earlier commit. Finally, it shows how to see the real commit with an empty --ignore-revs-file. Each claim was checked locally. With the ignore file, blame attributes the new frontend-format-check Make target and the new CI format-check step to older, unrelated commits. With blame.ignoreRevsFile configured, --ignore-revs-file="" restores attribution to the squash commit. The ignore file is unchanged since round 3, the whole branch still changes only that file and CONTRIBUTING.md, origin/main has not moved, and the review-record validator passed.

prior_finding_dispositions.rationale: Commit 430e12e rewords the CONTRIBUTING.md paragraph to describe the listed commits as mostly mechanical formatting, states that blame also skips the TASK-066B CI, Makefile and documentation lines, and documents how to see their real commit.
